attrs.statedReason: Cross-platform boundary for the persistent PTY backend, including ConPTY on Windows. Pulled in by @earendil-works/pi-ai (optional LLM API backend). pnpm lists them only because they ship lifecycle scripts, but those are no-ops we don't need, so we deny them — install still succeeds.

Cross-platform boundary for the persistent PTY backend, including ConPTY on Windows. Pulled in by @earendil-works/pi-ai (optional LLM API backend). pnpm lists them only because they ship lifecycle scripts, but those are no-ops we don't need, so we deny them — install still succeeds.

Native Codex and Claude tests qualify this exact release with its local patches. Office engines and their API are qualified and released together by the kit repository. Fresh pi-ai releases carry the model catalog updates that are the whole point of bumping it; waiting out the release age would defeat that.
